info.title: InstaSearch API Contract
info.description: Public discovery prototype with isolated provider contexts and five-minute persistent exact snapshots. Search-job polling/cancellation requires the per-job bearer token; operator recovery requires server credentials. Quote tokens reset on restart. The local basket is app-owned; explicit Northfork checkout routes can hand selected products to the selected Northfork-enabled retailer cart, but never place orders. Requested ZIP, provider acknowledgment, store branch and delivery serviceability are distinct evidence levels. Optional v0.7 freshness scheduling preserves five-minute quote expiry. Catalog descriptions remain browsable with expired prices explicitly labeled; background refresh never renews an existing search_id. Cache-only never schedules refresh. Provider tests add isolated, explicitly selected X-Byte/FoodSpark and Northfork reads plus synthetic Actowiz schema fixtures. They never fall back or issue shopping quotes. Live tests require a dedicated token, enable flag and separate persistent read allowance. MealMe/Satsuma and the Vercel Kroger/Square adapters are retired. Normal shopping search prefers X-Byte/FoodSpark only with configured server access, a retailer slug and a full address; otherwise it uses browser discovery. X-Byte errors never trigger fallback. Legacy comparison fetches through the browser but can reuse cached X-Byte observations with their original source provenance. Catalog all excludes retired sources. Explicit retired-provider selections return HTTP 410 provider_removed. Version 0.10.1 explicitly documents existing partial/cache-miss/job/savings and operational envelopes without changing their wire field types. /health is liveness; /ready checks storage only.

422.description: invalid_request: malformed input; location_required or location_unsupported: the selected supplier could not establish or support the requested location. No automatic relaxation or supplier fallback.

429.description: Busy or rate limited; back off

502.description: Provider failure, including provider_timeout, provider_blocked, login_required, provider_quota, no_results, provider_context_changed or connector_error. No substitute provider/data is returned.

409.description: cancelled: explicit search cancellation; do not treat as an empty successful search.

post.description: One to three nonblank query strings, maximum 120 characters each; duplicates are trimmed/deduplicated. queries takes precedence over query. A five-digit ZIP is required through zip or location.postal_code. With configured key + retailer + full address, new shopping fetches use X-Byte/FoodSpark; otherwise the browser. No fallback after an X-Byte error. Request bodies are 1–10000 UTF-8 JSON bytes. Decode all HTTP 200 variants by status. Both search routes require CONNECTOR_ENABLED on the server; clients do not supply supplier credentials.

post.description: This compatibility route accepts only the instacart catalog namespace. Fresh fetches use the Instacart browser, while cached observations can originate from X-Byte and retain their source_provider. For explicit fresh X-Byte or Northfork reads use /api/v1/provider-tests/compare. Retired selections return HTTP 410 provider_removed before upstream work. No automatic supplier fallback occurs.

get.summary: List Northfork-enabled grocery stores for a ZIP
get.description: Returns the Northfork retailers and store locations enabled for this account and ZIP. Instacart-backed stores are allowed for Schnucks and other eligible retailers. Walmart, Kroger and Target require direct Northfork provider rows; Instacart-backed rows for those chains are omitted.

provider.description: Northfork retailer/provider identifier for this store.

checkout_available.description: False when no allowed provider/store integration is enabled for this ZIP.

excluded_instacart_direct_only_store_cou.description: Instacart-backed Walmart, Kroger or Target rows omitted because those retailers require direct Northfork integration.

post.summary: Resolve selected X-Byte products against a Northfork store
post.description: Requires a live X-Byte grocery search result and a Northfork-enabled store for the same retailer and ZIP. Select store_id and store_provider from /checkout/stores. Returns Northfork product candidates; it does not write a cart.

store_provider.description: The provider identifier returned for the selected Northfork store.

409.description: Search expired, unsupported source, direct provider required for Walmart/Kroger/Target, or retailer/store mismatch

post.summary: Create a retailer cart handoff through Northfork
post.description: Transfers explicitly selected Northfork products and quantities for the selected store. Returns Northfork’s retailer-specific 3xx Location for the app/browser to open. Redirects are not followed and orders are never placed by this API.

retailer_provider.description: Northfork provider identifier for the selected retailer.

502.description: Northfork did not return a valid HTTPS retailer cart handoff URL

price.description: Observed USD price as a JSON number. On an expired catalog item it remains historical; price_fresh/selectable and quote expiry govern reuse. Use decimal arithmetic for money.

url.description: Provider product link when returned. May be null for X-Byte/FoodSpark; do not invent a handoff URL.

image_url.description: Optional HTTPS thumbnail. Display a placeholder if missing or loading fails.

last_seen_price.description: Historical observed price; not permission to quote or add an expired offer.

price_status.description: Catalog observation freshness; selection additionally requires compatible provider context.

local_offer_eligible.description: Requires acknowledged matching context, unexpired price and verified primary charge basis. A numeric price or selectable catalog flag alone does not satisfy savings eligibility.

provider.description: Legacy cache/catalog namespace; not the identity of the upstream fetch transport.

context_id.description: Opaque location/session identity. Compare exact values; never construct one from a ZIP or address.

Product.description: Normalized current shopping product. Optional evidence fields can be absent in retained observations. Nullable size, image_url, url and availability must be handled explicitly. Provider-test items use a separate model.

provider_context.description: Optional browser evidence. FoodSpark does not currently emit this nested object; do not require it to decode a search.

Location.description: verified means acknowledged requested ZIP/context for these observations, not store stock, a verified branch or delivery serviceability. context_id is opaque and optional in catalog/cache-miss/error envelopes.

Cache.description: Non-sliding freshness metadata. Search uses sources; catalog uses singular source. Cache reads never renew an issued search_id or its price expiry.

retailer.description: Retailer slug. With full location.address and configured server access, normal shopping search uses X-Byte/FoodSpark. Empty uses browser discovery.

allow_unverified_location.description: Explicit consent to non-local demo results; never implies ZIP verification.

mode.description: auto reuses fresh exact snapshots and fetches misses; cache_only never fetches/schedules refresh; refresh asks for a fresh snapshot (concurrent refreshes may coalesce). On this synchronous route, legacy live and catalog are cache-first aliases of auto. Only /compare mode=catalog is stored discovery-only.

SearchRequest.description: One to three nonblank query strings, maximum 120 characters each; duplicates are trimmed/deduplicated. queries takes precedence over query. A five-digit ZIP is required through zip or location.postal_code. With configured key + retailer + full address, new shopping fetches use X-Byte/FoodSpark; otherwise the browser. No fallback after an X-Byte error. Request bodies are 1–10000 UTF-8 JSON bytes.

SearchResponse.description: Discriminate by status: ok/partial have a search_id; cache_miss does not. The same union appears in succeeded async jobs.

CatalogResponse.description: Stored discovery only; no upstream search. search_id is created on every response but a server quote is retained only if at least one item is selectable. Cache.expires_in is zero when there are no selectable items.

Error.description: Non-2xx failure. Read error first, otherwise status. Some legacy failures omit message, items or location; an empty items array does not indicate a successful search. Request-shape failures use invalid_request. Ignore additional response fields for forward compatibility.

SelectionRequest.description: Select at most 60 IDs from one live server search snapshot. Duplicate IDs are deduplicated before subtotal; unknown IDs return 422. Missing/expired search IDs return 404 search_expired.

CartRequest.description: Local cart validation. Omitted lines and an empty array both produce an empty cart response. Reject duplicate (search_id,item_id) pairs; quantities are integer 1–99. No server basket is persisted.

item_count.description: Sum of quantities, not the number of distinct product lines.

zip.description: Omit or pass null to invalidate the retailer across all ZIPs; * plus no ZIP is global invalidation.

InvalidateRequest.description: Public prototype maintenance endpoint, not part of routine app search. Rate-limited once per (retailer,ZIP) group per minute. Does not require OperatorBearer in the current implementation.

Health.description: Process liveness and loaded contract version; not proof of upstream provider availability.

currency.description: Observed currency. Current normalized priced shopping items use USD; retained metadata may be incomplete.

url.description: Provider product link when returned. May be null for X-Byte/FoodSpark; do not invent a handoff URL.

image_url.description: Optional HTTPS thumbnail. Display a placeholder if missing or loading fails.

ComparisonItem.description: Observation from browser fetch or shared cache/catalog (possibly X-Byte). Never a shopping quote. Retained older observations may omit optional product/evidence fields.

line2.description: Optional apartment/unit line. Empty string is accepted.

LocationInput.description: Supply postal_code here or top-level zip. If both are present they must match. country_code defaults to US. Address or coordinates can be supplied, but an adapter may return location_unsupported; providing location is not verification.

browser_mode.description: Controls only the browser branch. Defaults to mode, or auto when mode is omitted. Direct anonymous HTTP always runs, including browser_mode=cache_only.

HttpComparisonRequest.description: Exactly one query after deduplication. The direct branch always attempts a public HTTP read; browser_mode=cache_only is not a no-upstream option for the whole endpoint. Does not create shopping quotes.

ProviderContext.description: Optional browser-specific evidence. Configured authorized state does not prove authenticated access or delivery eligibility.

job_token.description: Opaque short-lived capability. Keep in memory; send only as Authorization bearer header.

expires_in.description: Job retention lifetime from creation; currently 600 seconds. Separate from the shorter price quote expiry.

SearchJobAccepted.description: The only response that reveals job_token. Job may already be running by the time this queued acknowledgment arrives.

created_at.description: Unix epoch seconds (JSON number), not an ISO string.

anyOf.description: Unix epoch seconds (JSON number), not an ISO string.
Unix epoch seconds (JSON number), not an ISO string.

SearchJobStatus.description: HTTP 200 is job retrieval success, not provider success. Poll queued/running; succeeded result can be ok, partial or cache_miss. failed/cancelled expose error.code/message. A cancel request may return running with cancel_requested=true; only terminal cancelled confirms cancellation. Completion can win the race. Unknown/expired job IDs and invalid/missing bearer tokens all return 403 job_access_denied.

options.description: Northfork only. Other suppliers accept an empty options object. Stock filtering is optional.

ProviderTestRequest.description: Choose exactly one supplier. Synthetic fixture mode is the default. The supported live operation is ingredient/keyword grocery search. Actowiz returns unsupported_operation in live mode; its fixture is a known-product response sample.

northfork.description: Northfork only. Other suppliers accept an empty options object. Stock filtering is optional.

ProviderTestCompareRequest.description: Run explicitly selected suppliers independently. Per-provider options are keyed by supplier ID. A 200 response may contain individual supplier errors; inspect each outcome.

live.description: False for synthetic or historical observations; mode=live indicates retrieval, not freshness or checkout verification.

ProviderTestItem.description: Canonical observation. Northfork USD integer price uses minor units; X-Byte and Actowiz major-unit prices are not divided by 100. Null values remain unknown. requested_zip and observed branch ZIP are separate. Fixture records are synthetic. This object is never accepted as a shopping quote. Additional quality fields may be supplied.

status.description: live_ready means configuration and local allowance pass; it does not verify current upstream availability, an address match or successful inventory.

SourceProvider.description: Actual shopping fetch transport, independent of the legacy instacart cache/provider namespace.

retailer.description: Retailer slug. With full location.address and configured server access, normal shopping search uses X-Byte/FoodSpark. Empty uses browser discovery.

allow_unverified_location.description: Explicit consent to non-local demo results; never implies ZIP verification.

mode.description: Jobs reject legacy live/catalog modes. Each accepted creation is rate-limited even for cache_only.

A five-digit ZIP is required through zip or location.postal_code. With configured key + retailer + full address, new shopping fetches use X-Byte/FoodSpark; otherwise the browser. No fallback after an X-Byte error. Request bodies are 1–10000 UTF-8 JSON bytes.

retailer.description: Retailer slug. With full location.address and configured server access, normal shopping search uses X-Byte/FoodSpark. Empty uses browser discovery.

allow_unverified_location.description: Explicit consent to non-local demo results; never implies ZIP verification.

mode.description: catalog reads retained discovery rows; cache_only reads fresh exact snapshots; neither sends an upstream request. live/auto reuse fresh exact snapshots; refresh requests a browser fetch. Cached observations can originate from X-Byte.

providers.description: Only instacart is active. Duplicate values are deduplicated. Explicit retired names return 410 provider_removed; other unsupported names return 422 invalid_request.

ComparisonRequest.description: Observational legacy comparison. Fresh fetches use the browser; shared cache/catalog entries retain source_provider. Does not create shopping quote references.

Retailer.description: Returned retailer organization/slug, not verified branch availability. branch_verified is absent from FoodSpark retailer summaries.

SearchDiagnostic.description: Optional browser collection evidence. FoodSpark may return an empty diagnostics array. New diagnostic fields may be added without changing commerce DTOs.

source_providers.description: Transports represented by returned items, including mixed cached/fresh observations. Use per-item source_provider for labels.

SearchResultSuccess.description: HTTP 200 shopping result. partial means at least one requested query was not covered; partial_errors can explain an upstream failure while usable earlier results remain. expires_in is the earliest returned snapshot expiry. search_id is process-local and usable only until expiry/restart.

SearchCacheMiss.description: HTTP 200 cache_only miss. No search_id, top-level expires_in or cart_updated is emitted. Do not select, cart or calculate savings from this response.

price.description: Historical observed amount, which may be missing on incomplete retained metadata. Expiry does not erase a numeric amount: use price_fresh and selectable to decide eligibility.

currency.description: Observed currency. Current normalized priced shopping items use USD; retained metadata may be incomplete.

url.description: Provider product link when returned. May be null for X-Byte/FoodSpark; do not invent a handoff URL.

image_url.description: Optional HTTPS thumbnail. Display a placeholder if missing or loading fails.

last_seen_price.description: Historical observed price; not permission to quote or add an expired offer.

price_status.description: Catalog observation freshness; selection additionally requires compatible provider context.

local_offer_eligible.description: Requires acknowledged matching context, unexpired price and verified primary charge basis. A numeric price or selectable catalog flag alone does not satisfy savings eligibility.

provider.description: Legacy cache/catalog namespace; not the identity of the upstream fetch transport.

context_id.description: Opaque location/session identity. Compare exact values; never construct one from a ZIP or address.

CatalogItem.description: Retained observation with explicit freshness/context flags. Some fields introduced after an older snapshot was stored may be absent. A stale price remains a historical number, not a fresh quote. Only selectable items are stored in the catalog response search_id.

CatalogCounts.description: Counts exclude retired providers. Requested/observed ZIP counts do not prove branches or delivery coverage.

Readiness.description: Checks SQLite access. This does not probe suppliers or assert usable inventory.

SavingsRequest.description: Exactly two server-held, unexpired offer references. Client prices and unknown fields are rejected. Merchants must differ; product identity, name, size, USD charge basis and acknowledged context must match. Only per_item primary charge units qualify.

SavingsResponse.description: Observed merchandise comparison, not checkout/delivery pricing. original_subtotal uses the higher unit price; replacement_subtotal uses the lower price, regardless of request order. offers retains request order and adds each search_id. Percent uses original_subtotal as denominator (zero original => zero percent). Rounded to cents; expires_in is the earlier reference expiry.

comparison.description: Fresh comparison fetch transport; cached items can originate from X-Byte.

at.description: Unix epoch seconds (JSON number), not an ISO string.

cache_hit.description: Existing SQLite wire value, integer 0 or 1 (not boolean).

ProviderStatus.description: Configuration and recent comparison activity, not a live supplier availability probe. Retired names are informational only, never active choices.

next_due.description: Unix epoch seconds (JSON number), not an ISO string.

anyOf.description: Unix epoch seconds (JSON number), not an ISO string.

last_attempt.description: Unix epoch seconds (JSON number), not an ISO string.

last_requested.description: Unix epoch seconds (JSON number), not an ISO string.

paused_at.description: Unix epoch seconds (JSON number), not an ISO string.

IngestionPause.description: Retained provider pause evidence; legacy records may omit scope/timestamp details.

anyOf.description: Unix epoch seconds (JSON number), not an ISO string.

IngestionEnabled.description: Operational state. running means there is eligible scheduled work, not that inventory is fresh. All activity times are epoch seconds. Pause/error/active query and heartbeat can be null.

OperatorBearer.description: Server-local operator credential, never exposed in the public frontend.

SearchJobToken.description: Short-lived job capability returned only by job creation.

ProviderTestToken.description: Dedicated test token required only for mode=live. Never bundle it into a public/mobile application; use an authenticated development relay or enter it for an operator session. Fixture mode requires no token.
